scope: Admit the complete current native source roster and exact workflow transport transition before producing the unchanged original 195-component qualification domain.

inverse.current:
- name: Verify complete lossless evidence transport controls
        run: python3 -I -B runtime/tests/hia_native/test_evidence_transport.py

      - name: Verify the complete integrated source transition
        run: python3 -I -B runtime/tests/hia_native/test_integrated_source_transition.py -v

- name: Pack every admitted evidence member without repeated transport bytes
        id: transport
        run: |
          python3 -I -B runtime/scripts/hia_native_evidence_transport.py pack \
            --source "$RUNNER_TEMP/hia-runtime-native" \
            --output "$RUNNER_TEMP/hia-native-transport" \
            --runtime-sha "${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}" \
            --invocation "${{ needs.prepare.outputs.invocation }}" \
            --native-sha256 "${{ steps.original_inputs.outputs.native_sha256 }}" \
            --github-output "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

path: ${{ runner.temp }}/hia-native-transport/

      - name: Restore every admitted evidence member and verify its original identity
        run: |
          python3 -I -B runtime/scripts/hia_native_evidence_transport.py unpack \
            --source "$RUNNER_TEMP/hia-native-transport/evidence.tar.gz" \
            --output "$RUNNER_TEMP/hia-runtime-native" \
            --runtime-sha "${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}" \
            --invocation "${{ needs.native_collect.outputs.invocation }}" \
            --native-sha256 "${{ needs.native_collect.outputs.native_sha256 }}" \
            --archive-sha256 "${{ needs.native_collect.outputs.native_archive_sha256 }}" \
            --report "$RUNNER_TEMP/hia-native-transport/restored.json"

path: ${{ runner.temp }}/hia-native-transport/

      - name: Restore every admitted evidence member and verify its original identity
        run: |
          python3 -I -B runtime/scripts/hia_native_evidence_transport.py unpack \
            --source "$RUNNER_TEMP/hia-native-transport/evidence.tar.gz" \
            --output "$RUNNER_TEMP/hia-runtime-native" \
            --runtime-sha "${{ inputs.runtime-sha }}" \
            --invocation "${{ inputs.invocation }}" \
            --native-sha256 "${{ inputs.native-sha256 }}" \
            --archive-sha256 "${{ inputs.native-archive-sha256 }}" \
            --report "$RUNNER_TEMP/hia-native-transport/restored.json"
